people.name: Mario García Menocal
people.nameZh: 馬里奧·加西亞·梅諾卡爾

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、工程學位與獨立戰爭
heading.en: Birth, engineering degree and the war of independence

body.zh-Hant: 馬里奧·加西亞·梅諾卡爾生於1866年12月17日。他在美國康乃爾大學取得工程學位（1888年），隨後與身為運河工程師的叔父一同在尼加拉瓜工作，當地是當時設想的跨洋運河路線。他參加古巴獨立戰爭，據桑納爾所撰條目，他在革命政府中被任命為助理戰爭部長（1895年），並隨卡利斯托·加西亞將軍參與東部戰役；1897年因在圖納斯的一次戰略性勝利而晉升將軍。
body.en: Mario García Menocal was born on 17 December 1866. He earned an engineering degree at Cornell University in the United States (1888) and then worked in Nicaragua with his uncle, a noted canal engineer, on what was then a proposed trans-isthmian canal route. He took part in the Cuban War of Independence; according to Allan Sumnall's entry he was appointed assistant secretary of war in the revolutionary government (1895) and fought with General Calixto García in the Oriente campaign, and in 1897, after a strategic success at Tunas, he was promoted to general.

heading.zh-Hant: 哈瓦那警察局長、製糖事業與保守黨
heading.en: Havana police chief, sugar business and the Conservatives

body.zh-Hant: 他配合美國的干預，被任命為哈瓦那警察局長；卡尤埃拉·費爾南德斯寫道，他在1898年美國勝利後擔任此職，之後出任公共工程督察，並轉而經營大型製糖廠，特別是查帕拉大糖廠。卡尤埃拉·費爾南德斯稱他是古巴保守黨的領袖。1908年他代表保守黨競選總統，敗給由保守派轉入自由派的何塞·米格爾·戈麥斯。
body.en: He cooperated with the US intervention and was named Havana's chief of police. Cayuela Fernández writes that after the American victory of 1898 he was head of the Havana police and then inspector of public works, and that he then devoted himself to managing large sugar mills, above all the Gran Central Chaparra. Cayuela Fernández calls him the leader of the Cuban Conservative Party. In 1908 he ran for president on the Conservative Party ticket and was defeated by José Miguel Gómez, a Conservative who had turned Liberal.

heading.en: Election and two terms in office

body.zh-Hant: 1912年11月1日他當選古巴總統（美國國務院文件寫明）。美方文件另載，1913年5月20日他在就職典禮中午抵達宣誓就職，並於當日致電威爾遜。他任內共兩任，至1921年；卡尤埃拉·費爾南德斯寫他曾在1913與1917年為總統候選人，並對第二屆任內自由黨的起事施以嚴厲鎮壓。桑納爾稱其任內貪腐盛行，有372項針對公職人員的起訴，但這些起訴很少被認真追究，定罪也常因總統特赦或國會大赦而作廢；他1924年第三度競選總統失敗。
body.en: The State Department papers record that he was elected president of Cuba on 1 November 1912. The same papers show that on 20 May 1913, at noon, General Menocal arrived to take the oath of office, and that he sent a reply to Woodrow Wilson that day. He served two terms, until 1921; Cayuela Fernández notes that he was a presidential candidate in 1913 and 1917 and that in his second administration he harshly repressed the Liberal uprising. Sumnall writes that his presidency was fraught with corruption, with 372 indictments against public officials; indictments were rarely taken seriously and convictions were often negated through presidential pardons or congressional amnesties; his third attempt at the presidency in 1924 failed.

body.zh-Hant: 禮薩·汗（後來的禮薩·沙阿）生於貧寒家庭，據條目官方定為1878年3月16日，出生地在馬贊德蘭的阿拉什特。他的父親阿巴斯·阿里汗是馬贊德蘭省軍少校，嬰兒時期即去世；15歲時，在叔父安排下加入哥薩克旅。他在俄國教官手下晉升，至1918年於卡尚地區討伐部落軍閥的作戰中升為准將。1920年，英國軍官艾恩賽德少將安排撤換俄國軍官，並讓他在加茲溫指揮伊朗哥薩克部隊。
body.en: Reza Khan, later Reza Shah, was born into a family of modest means in Alasht in Mazandaran; the entry says his birth date was officially fixed as 16 March 1878. His father, Abbas Ali Khan, was a major in the Mazandaran provincial army and died while Reza was an infant; at fifteen he was steered by his uncle into the Cossack Brigade. He rose through the ranks under Russian instructors and by 1918, in the middle of a campaign against tribal warlords in the Kashan region, he was promoted to brigadier general. In 1920 the British officer Major-General Sir Edmund Ironside arranged the removal of the Russian officers and placed him in command of the Iranian Cossacks at Qazvin.

heading.en: The 1921 coup, war minister and prime minister

body.zh-Hant: 1921年2月21日，他與親英記者賽義德·齊亞丁·塔巴塔巴伊發動政變並控制德黑蘭。政變後他獲得「軍隊統帥」（Sardar-e Sipah）頭銜。他出任戰爭部長的時間，兩份條目說法不同：克羅寧寫5月，哈爾方德寫政變三週後。1923年10月他成為首相，哈爾方德把10月26日與這次任命連在一起寫。
body.en: On 21 February 1921, in partnership with the pro-British journalist Sayyid Zia al-Din Tabataba'i, he launched a coup and took control of Tehran. After the coup he received the title of Sardar-e Sipah, army commander. The two entries differ on when he became minister of war: Cronin writes that it was in May, Halfond that it was three weeks after the coup. In October 1923 he became prime minister, and Halfond ties 26 October to that appointment.

body.zh-Hant: 據哈爾方德，1925年12月12日議會宣布他為新沙阿；克羅寧則寫他於1926年4月登上王位。克羅寧另寫，1920年代後期推行了一系列激進的中央集權改革，1935年他在訪問凱末爾治下的土耳其後禁止婦女戴面紗。1941年8月25日英蘇兩軍入侵伊朗，他在9月16日被迫退位，流亡南非，1944年7月26日在流亡中去世。
body.en: According to Halfond, on 12 December 1925 the Majlis declared him the new shah, while Cronin writes that he ascended the throne in April 1926. Cronin adds that a number of radical, centralizing reforms were introduced in the late 1920s and that in 1935, after a visit to Atatürk's Turkey, he banned female veiling. On 25 August 1941 British and Soviet armies invaded Iran; on 16 September he was obliged to abdicate and went into exile in South Africa, where he died on 26 July 1944.

heading.en: Birth, education and proclamation as heir

body.zh-Hant: 亞歷山大一世（德國傳記資料庫記其生日為1888年12月4日，出生地采蒂涅）是彼得一世與佐爾卡的次子。他與兄長喬治一同進入聖彼得堡沙皇的侍從少年團並就讀該處的軍事高等學校，主要接受軍事教育；因健康欠佳，兩年後回到流亡於日內瓦的父親身邊。1903年父親成為塞爾維亞國王後，他也前往貝爾格萊德。兄長喬治行為失當、放棄王儲權利後，他於1909年3月29日被擁立為王儲。
body.en: Alexander I (the Deutsche Biographie gives his birth as 4 December 1888 in Cetinje) was the second son of Peter I and Zorka. With his brother George he entered the corps of pages of the tsar in St Petersburg and attended the military academy there, receiving mainly a military education; poor health forced him to return after two years to his father, who lived in exile in Geneva. When his father became King of Serbia in 1903 he too went to Belgrade. After his brother George, whose conduct had been erratic, had to give up his rights, Alexander was acclaimed heir to the throne on 29 March 1909.

heading.zh-Hant: 巴爾幹戰爭與出任攝政
heading.en: The Balkan War and appointment as regent

body.zh-Hant: 在巴爾幹戰爭中他指揮第一軍，並參加科馬諾沃戰役。其後國王彼得患重病，塞爾維亞政府決定任命他為塞爾維亞攝政，日期為1914年6月11日；之後因老王健康狀況，這項攝政延續到他登基為止。
body.en: In the Balkan war he commanded the First Army and took part in the battle of Kumanovo. A serious illness of King Peter then led the Serbian government to appoint him regent of Serbia on 11 June 1914; because of the king's state of health the regency was then prolonged until he came to the throne.

heading.zh-Hant: 世界大戰期間與出任塞爾維亞克羅埃西亞斯洛維尼亞攝政
heading.en: The World War and the regency of the Serbs, Croats and Slovenes

body.zh-Hant: 據朗迪所撰條目，亞歷山大在世界大戰中沒有參與戰鬥，不過也隨父王與塞爾維亞政府一同經歷穿越阿爾巴尼亞的艱苦撤退，並由一艘義大利船載往布林迪西。他此後再流亡三年，直到1918年12月1日被宣布為塞爾維亞人、克羅埃西亞人與斯洛維尼亞人王國的攝政。
body.en: According to Oscar Randi's entry, Alexander took no part in fighting in the World War, but he made, with his father and the Serbian government, the painful retreat across Albania and was carried to safety at Brindisi by an Italian ship. He then lived three more years in exile, until on 1 December 1918 he was proclaimed regent of the Kingdom of the Serbs, Croats and Slovenes.

fu portato in salvo a Brindisi da una nave italiana
Visse altri tre anni in esilio
il 1° dicembre 1918 fu proclamato reggente del trono dei Serbi-Croati-Sloveni

heading.en: King, the 1929 dictatorship and his death

body.zh-Hant: 1921年8月16日父王彼得去世後，他成為塞爾維亞人、克羅埃西亞人與斯洛維尼亞人王國的國王。他於1922年6月8日與羅馬尼亞國王斐迪南之女瑪麗亞結婚。1929年1月6日，他在嘗試以憲政手段化解危機失敗後，解散議會、廢除憲法，並把內閣總理職位連同獨裁權力交給近衛軍司令彼得·日夫科維奇將軍。德國傳記資料庫記他於1934年10月9日在馬賽去世。
body.en: After the death of his father Peter on 16 August 1921 he became King of the Serbs, Croats and Slovenes. On 8 June 1922 he married Maria, daughter of King Ferdinand of Romania. On 6 January 1929, after trying in vain to resolve the crisis by constitutional means, he dissolved parliament and abolished the constitution, giving the premiership with dictatorial powers to General Petar Živković, commander of the royal guard. The Deutsche Biographie records that he died in Marseille on 9 October 1934.
